frontend_interaction_suggestions.implementation: Implement four HTML buttons alongside the SVG, with aria-controls pointing to an adjacent explanation region. Use the manifest node labels and descriptions. Keep native keyboard support and visible focus.
On selecting step 3, show the explicitly simulated example in HTML. Keep known and unchecked status visually distinct and readable without color.
Step 4 can open a review checklist. It must not imply execution approval or trigger writes. Any real Agent execution needs a separate explicitly authorized application flow.
Use the language-specific mobile SVG for narrow screens and desktop SVG for wide screens. Render at intrinsic aspect ratio. Provide meaningful alt text; avoid inaccessible SVG-only click targets.

disclaimer: These static teaching illustrations do not execute an Agent, verify a real website, publish, modify content, or bypass permissions.
